title: DECLARE  PSALM 118 PRAYER EVERY MORNING AND WATCH YOUR LIFE CHANGE
text: Beloved, before we go into this place of communion with the spirit this morning, I want you to do something very significant. Share this prayer. Send it to somebody. There's a prophetic instruction embedded in sharing divine encounters. When you share the word of God, you are not just transferring information. You are releasing atmospheres. You are opening dimensions. You are creating pathways for the spirit of God to move in territories where darkness has held sway. So right now as the Holy Ghost is upon me, share this prayer with someone. Send it to that family member who needs a breakthrough. Send it to that friend who is going through a season of difficulty. Send it to that colleague who doesn't understand the times and seasons. Because what God is about to do through Psalm 118 this morning is not just for you. It is for generations. It is for bloodlines. It is for territories. Now, I want you to open your spirit. I don't want you to listen to me with your natural ears alone. There is a dimension of hearing that is spiritual. The Bible says, "He that has ears to hear, let him hear what the spirit is saying." This morning, the spirit of God wants to take us into Psalm 118. And I tell you, by the spirit of prophecy, this is not just another prayer session. This is a strategic military engagement in the realm of the spirit. Psalm 118 is a warfare psalm. It is a victory psalm. It is a psalm of the remnant. It is a psalm of those who have been surrounded by enemies and yet they refuse to bow. It is a psalm of those who have been written off by circumstances and yet they stood in the integrity of the word of God. When you study Psalm 118, you discover that this psalm was sung by the children of Israel when they were returning from Babylonian captivity. Think about that for a moment. These were people who had been displaced. These were people whose temple had been destroyed. These were people whose national identity had been questioned. These were people who had been told that their god was weaker than the gods of Babylon. And yet, after 70 years of captivity, after 70 years of mockery, after 70 years of waiting, when they began to return to Jerusalem, the song they sang was Psalm 118. This was not a song of complaint. This was not a song of bitterness. This was a song of triumph. This was a song of vindication. This was a song that declared that the mercy of the Lord endures forever. So this morning, if you have been in any form of captivity, if there has been any dimension of your life where the enemy has held you hostage, where circumstances have boxed you in, where limitations have defined your reality, I decree by the authority of the word of God that as we declare Psalm 118, the same spirit that brought Israel out of Babylon will bring you out of every captivity in the name of Jesus. Somebody shout hallelujah. Now let us begin. Oh give thanks unto the Lord for he is good for his mercy endures forever. I want you to understand something about thanksgiving. Thanksgiving is not just an emotional expression. Thanksgiving is a weapon. When you give thanks to God in the midst of battle, you are not denying the reality of the battle. You are establishing a greater reality. You are establishing the reality of God's faithfulness above the reality of your circumstances. The Bible says in everything give thanks. It didn't say for everything. It said in everything. There is a distinction. You may not be thankful for the trial but you can be thankful in the trial because you know that the one who permitted the trial is faithful. Let Israel now say that his mercy endures forever. Let the house of Aaron now say that his mercy endures forever. Let them that fear the Lord now say that his mercy endures forever. Do you see the pattern? This is corporate declaration. This is not individual faith alone. This is the gathering of the remnant to say that even when we have been scattered, even when we have been in exile, even when the enemy thought he had won, the mercy of the Lord endures forever. So this morning, I don't care what you have been through. I don't care how long the battle has been. I don't care how many times the enemy has attacked your mind. I decree that the mercy of the Lord over your life endures forever. It doesn't expire. It doesn't diminish. It doesn't fade. His mercy is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him. I called upon the Lord in distress and the Lord answered me and set me in a large place. Can I tell you something about distress? Distress is that place where you feel cornered. Distress is that place where options have run out. Distress is that place where human wisdom has failed. Distress is that place where the walls are closing in and you don't know which way to turn. But I prophesy to somebody, the place of distress is the place where God's intervention becomes most evident. Because when you call upon the Lord in distress, he doesn't just answer you. He sets you in a large place. From confinement to enlargement, from limitation to expansion, from bondage to liberty. The Lord is on my side. I will not fear. What can man do unto me? This is a declaration of confidence. When you know that the Lord is on your side, the question is not how big is the problem. The question is not how strong is the enemy. The question is what can man do unto me? Man can threaten. Man can intimidate. Man can conspire, man can plot, man can plan, but when the Lord is on your side, all the machinations of darkness amount to nothing. The Lord takes my part with them that help me. Therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me. This is not a prayer of vengeance. This is a prayer of vindication. There is a difference. When you pray for vindication, you are asking God to demonstrate that his word concerning you is true. You are asking God to silence the mockers. You are asking God to prove that what he has spoken over your life will come to pass. It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man. It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in princes. I need you to hear this very clearly. There is no human being no matter how powerful, no matter how connected, no matter how influential that can do for you what God can do for you. I'm not saying that men are not important. I'm not saying that relationships are not significant, but I'm saying that your primary trust, your foundational confidence must be in the Lord because men will fail you, systems will disappoint you, structures will collapse. But the Lord remains faithful. All nations compass me about, but in the name of the Lord will I destroy them. This is military language. This is warfare language. When the psalist says, "All nations compass me about," he's describing a situation of complete encirclement. Imagine being surrounded on every side. No escape route, no place to run, no place to hide. That is what the enemy does. The enemy loves to create the illusion of total defeat. The enemy loves to make you feel like there is no way out. But the psalist says in the name of the Lord will I destroy them. Not in my strength, not in my wisdom, not in my strategy, but in the name of the Lord. There is power in the name of Jesus. There is authority in that name. At the name of Jesus, every knee shall bow of things in heaven, things on earth, and things under the earth. They compass me about. Yay, they compass me about, but in the name of the Lord, I will destroy them. They compass me about like bees. They are quenched as the fire of thorns, for in the name of the Lord, I will destroy them. Do you see the repetition? This is not just poetry. This is prophetic insistence. This is spiritual militancy. When you are declaring the word of God in warfare, you don't just say it once and walk away. You keep declaring it until the atmosphere shifts. You keep declaring it until the enemy retreats. You keep declaring it until the victory manifests. So this morning, whatever has come past you about, I don't care how long it has been there. I don't care how strong it appears to be. In the name of the Lord, you will destroy it in the name of Jesus. Every encircumment is broken right now. Thou has thrust saw at me that I might fall, but the Lord helped me. This is a testimony. This is a witness. The enemy thrust saw at me. The attack was severe. The attack was intentional. The attack was designed to make me fall. But the Lord helped me. Can I tell you something? The help of the Lord is not cheap sympathy. The help of the Lord is divine intervention. When the Lord helps you, impossibilities become possibilities. When the Lord helps you, you stand where you should have fallen. When the Lord helps you, you survive what should have killed you. The Lord is my strength and song and has become my salvation. The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous. The right hand of the Lord does valiantly. The right hand of the Lord is exalted. The right hand of the Lord does valiantly. I shall not die, but live and declare the works of the Lord. Somebody needs to hear this. You shall not die. That sickness will not kill you. That depression will not destroy you. That financial crisis will not finish you. That family problem will not eliminate you. You shall not die but live. And not just live, but declare the works of the Lord. Your life will become a testimony. Your story will become a sermon. Your survival will become a sign to your generation. The Lord has chasened me Saul, but he has not given me over unto death. There is a difference between divine discipline and satanic destruction. When God chastens you, it is because he loves you. When God corrects you, it is because he has a plan for you. But even in his chastening, he does not give you over to death. He does not abandon you. He does not forsake you. So if you have been going through a season of correction, if you have been going through a season where God is dealing with you, don't interpret it as rejection. Interpret it as preparation. God is getting you ready for what he has prepared for you. Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will go into them and I will praise the Lord. This is the gate of the Lord into which the righteous shall enter. I will praise thee for thou has heard me and had become my salvation. The stone which the builders refused is become the headstone of the corner. Can we talk about this for a moment? The stone which the builders refused. Think about Joseph. He was refused by his brothers. They threw him into a pit. They sold him into slavery. But the stone which the builders refused became the headstone of the corner. Joseph became the prime minister of Egypt. Think about David. He was refused by his family. Even his own father didn't consider him worthy to be presented before the prophet. But the stone which the builders refused became the headstone of the corner. David became the king of Israel. Think about Jesus. He was refused by the religious leaders. They crucified him. They buried him. But the stone which the builders refused became the headstone of the corner. He rose from the dead and is seated at the right hand of the father. So this morning, if you have been rejected, if you have been overlooked, if you have been underestimated, I prophesy to you that the rejection is positioning you for divine selection. What men refuse, God uses. This is the Lord's doing. It is marvelous in our eyes. This is the day which the Lord has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it. I want you to catch this. This is the day. Not yesterday, not tomorrow. This day, the day which the Lord has made, God has made this day. He has fashioned it. He has designed it. And because he has made it, we will rejoice and be glad in it. Your rejoicing is not dependent on circumstances. Your gladness is not conditional on everything being perfect. You rejoice because this is the day that the Lord has made. Save now. I beseech thee, oh Lord. Oh Lord, I beseech thee. Send now prosperity. Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord. We have blessed you out of the house of the Lord. God is the Lord which has showed us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords even unto the horns of the altar. Thou art my God and I will praise thee. Thou art my God, I will exalt thee. Oh, give thanks unto the Lord for he is good. For his mercy endures forever. Now let us pray. Father, in the name of Jesus, we come before you this morning with hearts full of gratitude. We come before you acknowledging that you are good and that your mercy endures forever. Lord, we thank you because even when we were in distress, you answered us and set us in a large place. We thank you because you are on our side and we will not fear what man can do unto us. We thank you because you take our part with them that help us and we shall see our desire upon them that hate us. Father, in the name of Jesus, we declare that every encirclement is broken right now. Every nation that has compassed us about, every enemy that has surrounded us, every limitation that has boxed us in, we destroy them in the name of the Lord. Just as beasts are quenched as the fire of thorns, so shall every organized attack against our lives be quenched. Right now in the name of Jesus, we declare that though the enemy has thrust saw at us that we might fall, the Lord is our helper and we shall not fall. We shall stand. We shall prevail. We shall overcome. Lord, we receive you as our strength and our song. We declare that you are our salvation. We prophesy that the voice of rejoicing and salvation is in our dwelling places. The right hand of the Lord is doing valiantly in our lives. The right hand of the Lord is exalted over every situation. We shall not die but live and declare the works of the Lord. Every plan of death is cancelled. Every assignment of destruction is terminated. Every strategy of the enemy to cut us off is nullified in the name of Jesus. Father, we thank you that though you have chastened us, you have not given us over unto death. We receive your correction. We receive your discipline. We embrace your dealings. But we reject every satanic manipulation that tries to take advantage of the season of correction. We declare that we are coming out of this season stronger, wiser, better, and more effective for the kingdom of God. Lord, we ask you to open unto us the gates of righteousness. Let every gate that has been shut against us be open right now. Let every door that the enemy has closed be opened by the key of David. We go into the gates of righteousness and we praise you. We thank you for you have heard us and you are our salvation. We declare that the stone which the builders refused has become the headstone of the corner. Every rejection we have experienced is now working for our divine selection. Every time we have been overlooked is now positioning us for divine appointment. What men refuse you are using for your glory. This is the Lord's doing and it is marvelous in our eyes. We declare that this is the day which the Lord has made and we will rejoice and be glad in it. We refuse to waste this day in sadness. We refuse to waste this day in depression. We refuse to waste this day in fear and anxiety. This is the day that the Lord has made and we choose to rejoice. We choose to be glad. We choose to walk in the victory that Christ has purchased for us. Father save now we pray. Send now prosperity into our lives. Not just financial prosperity but prosperity of soul, prosperity of relationships, prosperity of health, prosperity of purpose, prosperity of destiny. Let your blessing come upon us and overtake us. Let your favor surround us as a shield. Let your goodness and mercy follow us all the days of our lives. We declare that we are blessed in the name of the Lord. We have been blessed out of the house of the Lord and that blessing cannot be revoked. God, you are the Lord who has showed us light. Where there has been darkness, you have given us light. Where there has been confusion, you have given us clarity. Where there has been ignorance, you have given us revelation. We walk in the light as you are in the light. We bind the sacrifice with cords onto the horns of the altar. We are committed to you. We are consecrated unto you. We are dedicated to your purposes. You are our God and we will praise you. You are our God and we will exalt you. Oh, give thanks unto the Lord for his good, for his mercy endures forever. We give you thanks this morning. We give you praise this morning. We give you glory this morning because you are worthy. Because you are faithful, because you are true. Everything you have promised, you will perform. Every word you have spoken, you will establish. Every vision you have given, you will bring to pass. Father, in the name of Jesus, we take authority over every spirit of delay. We command every force that has been holding back our breakthroughs to release them now. We declare that this is our time, this is our season, this is our moment. What you have ordained for us from the foundation of the world, let it manifest now. Let it come forth now. Let it be established now. We refuse to wait any longer for what belongs to us by covenant. We step into the fullness of our inheritance in Christ Jesus. Every generational c is broken. Every ancestral limitation is destroyed. Every inherited pattern of failure is terminated in the name of Jesus. We are the head and not the tail. We are above only and not beneath. We are blessed in the city and blessed in the field. We are blessed when we come in and blessed when we go out. The Lord is commanding blessing upon our storehouses and upon all that we set our hands to do. We are the planting of the Lord that he might be glorified. We declare that no weapon formed against us shall prosper and every tongue that rises against us in judgment we shall condemn. This is our heritage as servants of the Lord. And our righteousness is from him. We are more than conquerors through him that loved us. We are victorious. We are overcomers. We are triumphant in Christ Jesus. Greater is he that is in us than he that is in the world. If God be for us, who can be against us? Father, we decree that your kingdom is coming in our lives. Your will is being done in our lives as it is in heaven. We are walking in divine alignment. We are walking in divine order. We are walking in divine timing. Everything is falling into place. Everything is working together for our good. Everything is serving the purposes of God in our lives. We are not victims of circumstances. We are not subject to the whims of the enemy. We are children of the most high God and we walk in the authority that Christ has given us. Every door that needs to open is opening now. Every opportunity that belongs to us is coming to us now. Every connection that we need is being established now. Every resource that we require is being released now. We are not lacking. We are not wanting. Our God supplies all our needs according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. We are complete in him. We are sufficient in him. We are equipped in him for every good work. We take authority over our minds. Every thought of fear is cast down. Every imagination of doubt is destroyed. Every stronghold of unbelief is pulled down. We bring every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ. We think on things that are true, honest, just, pure, lovely, and of good report. We have the mind of Christ. We think like God thinks. We see like God sees. We speak like God speaks. Our mouths are filled with praise. Our lips are anointed with grace. Our words carry power. Our declarations create atmospheres. What we bind on earth is bound in heaven. What we lose on earth is loosed in heaven. We are seated with Christ in heavenly places far above all principality and power and might and dominion. We operate from a place of victory. We function from a position of authority. We minister from a platform of triumph. Every chain is broken. Every bondage is shattered. Every limitation is removed. Every restriction is eliminated. We are free indeed. Whom the son sets free is free indeed. We walk in liberty. We walk in freedom. We walk in the glorious liberty of the children of God. The spirit of the Lord is upon us because he has anointed us to preach good tidings, to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, to open the prison to them that are bound, to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord. We are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a peculiar people that we should show forth the praises of him who has called us out of darkness into his marvelous light. We are the light of the world. We are the salt of the earth. We are ambassadors for Christ. We are ministers of reconciliation. We are the righteousness of God in Christ Jesus. We are joint hes with Christ. We are partakers of the divine nature. We are temples of the Holy Ghost. Father, let your glory fill our lives. Let your presence saturate our atmospheres. Let your power flow through our beings. Let your anointing rest upon us. Let your fire consume every impurity. Let your blood cleanse us from all unrighteousness. Let your spirit lead us into all truth. Let your word dwell in us richly. Let your love constrain us. Let your grace sustain us. Let your mercy preserve us. We declare that we are walking in the blessing of Abraham. The blessing of the Lord makes rich and adds no sorrow. We are blessed with faithful Abraham. The blessing is upon our heads. The blessing is upon our hands. The blessing is upon our families. The blessing is upon our businesses. The blessing is upon our ministries. The blessing is upon everything we touch. We are conduits of blessing. We are channels of grace. We are vessels of honor, sanctified and meet for the master's use. Every spirit of poverty is rebuked. Every spirit of lack is cast out. Every spirit of insufficiency is expelled in the name of Jesus. We serve the God of abundance. We serve the God of more than enough. We serve the God who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think according to the power that works in us. Our God is Jehovah Gyra, our provider. He owns the cattle on a thousand hills. The silver is his and the gold is his. He opens his hand and satisfies the desire of every living thing. We receive divine health. We receive divine strength. We receive divine vitality. By his stripes, we are healed. He sent his word and healed us and delivered us from all our destructions. The prayer of faith saves the sick and the Lord raises them up. The same spirit that raised Christ from the dead quickens our mortal bodies. We are strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. We can do all things through Christ who strengthens us. Our youth is renewed like the eagles. We mount up with wings as eagles. We run and are not weary. We walk and do not faint. Every assignment of the enemy is nullified. Every plan of darkness is frustrated. Every scheme of hell is demolished. We wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. But we are strong in the Lord. We put on the whole armor of God. We stand therefore having our loins girth about with truth, having on the breastplate of righteousness, our feet shaw with the preparation of the gospel of peace, taking the shield of faith, wherewith we are able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked, taking the helmet of salvation and the sword of the spirit, which is the word of God. We pray always with all prayer and supplication in the spirit. We watch with all perseverance. We are vigilant. We are alert. who are sensitive to the leading of the Holy Ghost. We hear his voice and we follow him. We are led by the spirit of God. We walk in the spirit and we do not fulfill the lust of the flesh. The fruit of the spirit is manifest in our lives. Love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith, meekness, temperance. Against such there is no law. Father, we commit our ways unto you. We trust in you and you bring it to pass. You make our righteousness to shine as the light and our judgment as the noon day. We rest in you. We wait patiently for you. We fret not ourselves in any way. We delight ourselves in you and you give us the desires of our hearts. Our times are in your hands. Our steps are ordered by you. You direct our paths. You make our way prosperous. You give us good success. We are partakers of your divine promises. Your word is settled in heaven. Your word is a lamp unto our feet and a light onto our path. Your word is quick and powerful and sharper than any two-edged sword. Your word does not return unto you void, but it accomplishes what you please and prospers in the thing whereto you sent it. We stand on your word. We build on your word. We live by your word. Heaven and earth shall pass away. But your word shall never pass away. Every curse is broken. Every hex is destroyed. Every spell is shattered. Every evil pronouncement is nullified. Every negative prophecy is canceled. We reverse every satanic decree. We overturn every demonic verdict. We annull every wicked covenant. We break every ungodly agreement. We renounce every alliance with darkness. We severe every tie with the kingdom of Satan. We are delivered from the power of darkness and translated into the kingdom of God's dear son. We have redemption through his blood. Even the forgiveness of sins. Father, we ask for divine speed. Accelerate your purposes in our lives. What should take years, let it happen in months. What should take months, let it happen in weeks. What should take weeks, let it happen in days. Let there be a sudden turnaround. Let there be a sudden breakthrough. Let there be a sudden manifestation. Let there be a suddenly of the Lord in our situations. We decree that delay is over. Stagnation is over. Limitation is over. It is our time to flourish. It is our time to prosper. It is our time to increase. It is our time to expand. We claim our territories. We possess our possessions. We recover all that the enemy has stolen. We take back what belongs to us. We reclaim our inheritance. We reestablish our boundaries. We rebuild our walls. We restore our foundations. We are repairers of the bridge. We are restorers of parts to dwell in. The glory of the latter house shall be greater than the former. What is coming is greater than what has been. Our best days are ahead of us. Our future is brighter than our past. In Jesus's mighty name we pray. And every spirit of darkness, every agent of Satan, every power of wickedness that has been assigned against us, we command you to bow in the name of Jesus. We render you powerless. We render you ineffective. We render you paralyzed. You have no authority over our lives. You have no claim over our destinies. You have no right to our blessings. We serve notice on you this morning that your time is up. Your season is over. Your assignment has failed. We overcome you by the blood of the lamb and by the word of our testimony. We decree that we are victorious. We decree that we are triumphant. We decree that we are more than conquerors. We decree that we are blessed. We decree that we are favored. We decree that we are anointed. We decree that we are appointed. We decree that we are chosen. We decree that we are called. We decree that we are equipped. We decree that we are empowered. We decree that we are enabled to fulfill every assignment that God has given us. We shall finish our course. We shall complete our assignment. We shall fulfill our destiny. We shall accomplish our purpose. We shall manifest our calling. To God be all the glory, honor, dominion, and power both now and forever more. In Jesus mighty name we have prayed. And somebody wherever you are, I want you to lift up your voice right now and give God a shout of victory. Give him a shout of praise. Give him a shout of triumph because Psalm 118 has been declared over your life and the mercy of the Lord endures forever. Amen. And amen.
